Thank you so much for confirming your interest in our internship at FloLabs! 🙂

Please add our domain to your safe senders list to ensure you don't miss any of our future emails.

As you have been accepted to the next stage, I copied and pasted the next steps in the process below. The orientation meeting will be held next week if you complete the steps below. Let me know if you have any questions.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━──────────────────────────────

Action Required: Please begin by reviewing our projects and websites to gain a comprehensive understanding of what we do. To help us get to know you beyond a resume, and to help you explore whether our projects resonate with your interests, we’ve put together a thoughtful form. Feedback Form: https://flolabsinnovations.fillout.com/t/besSHDQpaHus

Important: Ensure your responses are complete, original and NOT generated by AI tools, as applications with AI-generated content or incomplete will not be approved. We value authenticity and thoughtful participation, so please ensure your responses reflect your own insights and perspectives.

2. Next Steps After Form Submission:

Review Additional Materials: Engage with more in-depth content to further understand our initiatives.

Join Our Group Orientation Meeting: Participate in a group orientation session with John Hazlewood, Founder of FloLabs. John will share his journey in AI and Robotics, outline our business model, and discuss our innovative initiatives, followed by an open Q&A session. John's LinkedIn profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hazlewood/

We’re looking forward to your insights and seeing how your passion aligns with our innovative projects!

Sincerely,
HR Team
FloLabs Innovations Group

nodes.name: CHECK. Prior Sent Reply In Thread

parameters.text:
=You are classifying replies to this specific FloLabs internship email.

The original email asked the applicant to:
1. Watch the meeting recording.
2. Reply to confirm whether they would like to move forward.
3. Let us know if they are not interested.

Classify ONLY the applicant's new reply text.

Applicant reply:
"""
{{ $json.applicantReplyText }}
"""

Return JSON only:

{
  "candidateIntent": "move_forward | not_interested | question | unclear | other",
  "shouldSendNextStage": false,
  "shouldSendNotInterested": false,
  "shouldFlagManualReview": false,
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "reason": "brief reason based only on the applicant's words",
  "matchedSignals": ["exact phrase from the applicant reply"]
}

Rules:
- Use "move_forward" only when the applicant clearly confirms they want to continue, proceed, move forward, join the next stage, or remain interested.
- Set "shouldSendNextStage" to true only when candidateIntent is "move_forward" and confidence is high.
- Use "not_interested" only when the applicant clearly says they are not interested, want to withdraw, do not want to continue, are stepping back, or ask to be removed.
- Set "shouldSendNotInterested" to true only when candidateIntent is "not_interested" and confidence is high.
- Use "question" when the applicant asks about hours, fees, schedule, remote work, certificate, meetings, requirements, the recording link, or any clarification.
- Use "unclear" when the applicant says only something generic such as "thanks", "ok", "received", "done", or "I watched it" without clearly saying they want to move forward.
- For "question", "unclear", or "other", set shouldFlagManualReview to true.
- Never classify a question as not_interested.
- Never send a not interested reply unless the applicant clearly says they do not want to continue.
- Be conservative. If unsure, classify as unclear and flag for manual review.

options.systemMessage:
You are a strict intent classifier for recruitment email replies.

You will be given ONLY the new text a job applicant wrote in their reply. You will NOT receive quoted history, email headers, or any other context. Judge intent solely from the words the applicant wrote.

Return shouldSendNextStage = true ONLY when the applicant clearly and affirmatively confirms they want to continue, proceed, or move forward.

Return shouldSendNextStage = false when the applicant:
- withdraws, declines, or says they are not interested
- says they will not move forward, or not at this time
- asks to be removed
- pauses or cancels
- only asks a question
- writes anything unclear, generic, or non-committal (for example "ok", "thanks", "received")

Be conservative. If the intent is not a clear, affirmative yes, return false.

Return JSON only. No markdown. No text outside the JSON.

json.html:
Hi Paula,

Thank you for the information. I’ve watched the meeting recording and I’d like to move forward, specifically for the Ethical and Legal Research Intern role.

I’m based in Tallinn, so I’d be joining remotely. I’ve genuinely enjoyed seeing the range of what FloLabs is building — CAIPO, FlowBrain, Mood Changer all tackle different problems in interesting ways, and that breadth is part of what drew me to apply.

One specific area I had a keen interest was FlowBrain’s planned AI “Buddies” for legal, health, and data use cases. A few of those verticals could trigger high-risk obligations under the EU AI Act once FlowBrain looks at EU markets, so It would be worth exploring a short classification analysis mapping each vertical against those triggers something concrete the team can use early, before development goes further.

I currently work in documents and identity verification at Veriff, which is where most of my regulatory background comes from, and I’m happy to share more detail whenever useful.


Looking forward to hearing from you.


Best regards,
Aizaz Ahmad
Tallinn, Estonia
